source_scope: Round 70: printed Chapters 1112–1121. Two independently read Chinese full-text mirrors, Bq8xsw and Bqquge, agree on chapter title sequence; multiple Vietnamese editions/catalogs checked for translated title and numbering alignment.

confirmed_outcomes.event: Phase II opens; Sarah Blade Dance destroys one Eternal Disaster Nest and receives 1,000,000 battle score, 1,000,000 Ice Dragon Marks, 1 Gold Point, and 100 reputation. A second nearby nest destruction has truncated reward text and is not separately quantified.

By 06:21, Xinghuo City reports 115 cumulative nest clears, 115,000,000 points, 115,000,000 marks, 115 Gold Points, and 11,500 reputation; 114 incremental clears/reward units recorded here after deduplicating the Chapter 1112 clear.
Divine-level Ice Nest monsters enter combat; no quantified item receipt.
Five divine-level Ice Nest kills reported; five Doomah Frostblood Crystals and per-kill score/Gold Point quantities recorded.
Three further divine kills reported; outputs derived from Chapter 1111 per-kill rule. A later named kill may overlap this group and is not added separately.
Dragon and truth-god combat; no counted receipt.
Deweina's Life Blessing and Abedon's Earth Blessing apply to survivors for 72 hours; Lí Lan's Eternal Force talent makes her instances permanent.
After six battle days, cumulative divine Ice Nest kills reach 495. 487 additional kills and corresponding rule-based reward quantities recorded after subtracting the 5 + 3 already logged.
The Phase II timer reaches zero but the event continues with the ancient dragon's compulsion domain; one revival is used in narrative, but it is not a new grant.
Truth gods attack the ice dragon; chapter ends without campaign settlement or item receipt.

unresolved_conflicts: Vietnamese chapter numbering differs by edition and segmentation: Cơm Nguội's page labeled Ch.1116 corresponds by translated title to Chinese printed Ch.1112 (+4 offset); Bách Ngọc Sách and TruyệnYY expose split-segment counts; Xa Lộ Sách/Xalosach displays a 2,734 chapter catalog, and NovOne mirrors those 2,734 chapter links. Do not map Vietnamese chapter number to Chinese print number without matching title.
Cơm Nguội's current Vietnamese chapter body prompts for login; no login was attempted. The live title association and catalog metadata were used only for edition alignment, not reward quantities.
Chapter 1113 nest-clear totals are cumulative. Chapter 1112 explicitly records one prior clear, so Round 70 records 114 net clear rewards for Ch1113 to avoid double counting.
Chapter 1119's 495 kills are cumulative. Previously recorded explicit groups are 5 (Ch1115) and 3 (Ch1116); the 487 remainder is derived and valued using the Ch1111 per-kill rule.
non_receipts: Ch1112 second nest destruction reward panel is truncated; it is not separately quantified.
Ch1114 combat descriptions do not identify a countable receipt.
Ch1116's three extra divine kills are counted by explicit narrative count; the rewards are mechanically derived from the Ch1111 rule and should be distinguished from directly enumerated loot.
Ch1118 blessings are event status effects, not consumable inventory.
Ch1120 revival is a previously granted one-time event ability being used, not a new item or new grant.
Ch1121 has no campaign settlement; later settlement chapter is outside this round.
